title: Mamata Banerjee ‘removed’ from her own party, TMC? Abhishek ‘suspended’? Let’s fact-check the ‘comedy show’
description: Bengal politics experienced turmoil as a rebel faction within the Trinamool Congress claimed to be the real TMC and removed Mamata Banerjee as chairperson. They also suspended Abhishek Banerjee. Let's find out if it's legally acceptable.
